title: Projects
subtitle: Selected work — platforms I've built and scaled.

items.title: Creazilla
items.summary: Backend for a platform serving 10M+ free graphics with Elasticsearch search and Redis caching.
items.challenge: Serve millions of graphic assets with fast search and stable performance under high traffic.
approach: Architected backend with NestJS and queue-based processing
Elasticsearch for sub-200ms asset search
MongoDB for flexible document storage
Redis caching and Bull Queue for background jobs
Multi-server deployment with CDN integration

items.title: Kaluwala.in
items.summary: Village tourism platform with Sanity CMS and a Telegram bot for community photo contributions.
items.challenge: Enable easy content contributions from a remote village with moderation and real-time blog alerts.
approach: Next.js tourism site with SEO-first structure
Sanity CMS for blog and content management
Telegram bot on Cloudflare Workers for uploads
Admin moderation workflow
Interactive village map with Leaflet.js

items.title: ExploreWithNurse
items.summary: Travel blog with headless CMS, SEO-optimised pages, and strong Core Web Vitals.
items.challenge: A performant blog that ranks well and works on slow mobile networks with self-service publishing.
approach: Next.js App Router with SSG/ISR
Sanity CMS with live preview
JSON-LD structured data for SEO
Image optimisation with WebP
Deployed on Vercel with edge caching

items.title: Addy — Artist Gallery
items.summary: Portfolio site for a digital artist to showcase sketches across digital art, traditional art, and manga panels.
items.challenge: Give a digital artist a clean way to publish and browse sketches by medium — digital, traditional, and manga — without needing developer help.
approach: Built a category-based gallery with Next.js and Sanity CMS
Organised artwork into Digital Art, Traditional Art, and Manga Panels
Optimised image delivery via Next.js Image and Sanity CDN
Simple navigation with Gallery and About pages
Social links for Instagram and Reddit

items.title: Studio Youkai
items.summary: Sketch and illustration portfolio for a digital artist — gallery of original artwork and story illustrations.
items.challenge: Create a welcoming portfolio for an artist to share sketches, digital art, and story illustrations with an easy-to-browse gallery experience.
approach: Designed a minimal landing page with clear gallery and about CTAs
Built a sketch portfolio with Sanity-backed content management
Highlighted original sketches, digital art, and story illustrations
Mobile-first layout with fast image loading
Deployed on rootz491.com subdomain
